items.text: Evidence references are immutable.

evidence.name: B21-10-03 writing different content under an existing name keeps the original and stores a new version
B21-10-03 writing identical content again is idempotent and creates no new file
B21-10-03 concurrent writes with different content never lose or overwrite a version
B21-10-03 verifyEvidence detects tampering, a missing file and a reference outside the evidence root
B21-10-03 the manifest verifies every listed item and reports the one that was altered
B21-10-03 model-controlled names cannot write outside the run evidence directory

items.note: Fixed by Claude Code (was CONFIRMED_GAP): evidence is write-once through writeImmutable (exclusive create); different content becomes a new .vN file, identical content is idempotent, references can be re-verified by hash. Worker Report, verifier evidence, Review Report, review input, repo-knowledge manifest and verified.patch all use it. Design choice: a conflicting write is stored as a new version instead of being rejected, because rework legitimately rewrites the same name. Sabotage-checked six ways. Also fixes a path-traversal route: planner task ids and evidence names are sanitized.
